stem: Which line from the poem best helps the reader picture the speaker's sandcastle?

options.label: A
options.text: Let's fill a bucket with water and pour it on the land.

options.label: B
options.text: To make the sand muddy and damp, to work with it by hand.

options.label: C
options.text: To start a mighty castle on the playground made of sand.

options.label: D
options.text: Then make the sand like towers; form walls that stretch up high.
